companyFieldUpdates.description: Plug Power Fuel Cell Asset SPVs is an archived generic financing construct rather than a manager-level operating portfolio company. Plug Power filings document separate sale-leaseback lessors that held title to specified fuel-cell equipment beginning in 2016-2017, followed by a US$100 million secured Generate Lending facility announced in 2019. The Generate loan was debt rather than equity and Plug Power reported repaying it in full in December 2022. Public filings reviewed through August 29, 2026 did not identify an equity conversion, foreclosure, renewed Generate ownership or a current consolidated Generate-owned Plug Power SPV platform. The exact residual disposition of every historical leased-equipment vehicle was not publicly disclosed, but that gap does not support retaining this generic row as an active direct infrastructure holding.
